title: KAITO — Mentors We Can Count On〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One month before the solo show
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just one month to go until the girls' solo show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm so fired up about it...
I mean, we've been watching over them for so long, and their big moment's finally arrived.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand how you feel. They've been making a concerted effort to make sure their fans really enjoy the show, so I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only that, but they did great during Airi's training camp.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they did. I'm sure their fans are just as excited for the show as we are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, they arrived right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO! And MEIKO and Luka too!
Do you all have a second?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, how can we help?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We apologize in advance since we're not sure if we should be asking you about this, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. So this is about setting up your venue and figuring out a designated route for the audience...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For the fan event we did the other day, we were able to come up with a plan for all that with the help of the staff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we ran into some trouble when it came to actually setting everything up, which led to quite a bit of confusion among everyone. We were hoping to avoid that this time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Considering how this event's gonna be even bigger and means a lot more than that one, we can't let the same thing happen again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why we're here right now. With our previous mistakes in mind, we'd like to ask for your opinions regarding this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Will you help us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! I'll be more than happy to!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, since you've all been working very hard towards making your solo show a success. As such, I'd like to help you girls out in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Getting to work on your behind the scenes for your big show sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You really are an open book, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. What's wrong with being honest about how I feel?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Plus, working on their show behind-the-scenes means we're helping them shine on stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe idols have the ability to spread hope to not just their fans but also inspire all of those who help make their shows happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Imagine putting together the stage on which your favorite idols are going to shine like the sun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That'd definitely put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. We've been wondering how the preparations for your show were going, so getting to help out like this is nice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree! We'd be honored to lend you girls a hand♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, we'll need to make haste.
Do you have the layout for your venue along with a list of equipment?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, we also brought the instructions for where to carry and set up everything, the song files for the show and even the schedule for the day of.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The schedule Airi made is really incredible!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: With just one look it tells you exactly when and where you're supposed to be, what outfit you should be wearing and where you need to enter from!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: FYI, it wouldn't be doing its job if you couldn't tell at a glance what you're supposed to be doing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I agree with Minori. It's very easy to pick out the information one needs. I think I'll use this for future reference.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! See?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You seem way happier than I am about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, KAITO, do you think you have enough information to help us...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, what you've given me should be more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. So, let's begin with how everything is going to be set up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much!
You've given us such wonderful advice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It was our pleasure.
If anything, it was wonderful to see exactly how your solo show was coming along. And it was very fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO's right. We were happy to help. Besides, doesn't the saying go “necessity is the mother of invention?”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like it's a tad bit different in this case.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In any case, we're all looking forward to seeing you all shine on stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Do you think you'll have any merchandise to spare?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If possible, we'd like to use what we can get to cheer you all on during the show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You sly fox...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that would make watching their show just that much more fun♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I totally agree! You've all been there for us until now, so we'll bring some over for all of you guys.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good luck, girls.
I don't think any of us can wait at this point.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you! We promise to bring you the best solo show ever!
